Highlights:
- 500K+ calls/month handled by voice AI agents at a 70%+ containment rate, cutting escalations to human agents by 30% (PolyAI)
- 10+ enterprise clients taken through development, deployment, and hypercare (PolyAI)
- 15% lower word error rate from ASR (NVIDIA) and TTS (ElevenLabs) tuning (PolyAI)
- 40% fewer false interruptions from VAD and barge-in handling (PolyAI)
- 300ms lower perceived end-to-end latency from audio caching, guardrails, and runtime optimizations (PolyAI)
- RAG pipeline connecting a knowledge base to voice AI agents for customer FAQs (Replicant)

Core skills: AI agents, conversational AI, voice AI, LLM integration, prompt engineering, tool-calling, RAG pipelines, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Claude Code, Agent Skills, ASR, TTS, SIP trunking, Twilio, Python, TypeScript, Golang, Node.js, React, Next.js, FastAPI, AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Datadog, PostgreSQL.
